body: New SudokuCommand: cosmetic strikeLightningEffect + setHealth(0.0) guaranteed KO, no killer LivingEntity so CustodyListener's Enforcement-check never fires (doesn't jail the player). Registered in GTA7Plugin.onEnable, plugin.yml commands.sudoku entry added, self-service (no op gate) matching FlowCommand's pattern. mvn package builds clean (target/gta7-0.1.0.jar). Not deployed to the live EINHORN_SURVIVAL server yet -- only deploy path documented is a full systemctl --user restart einhorn-survival.service, which drops connected players (feedback-respawn-not-reboot convention flags this as a known gap); holding off on the restart pending founder confirmation. Commit GTA7 c3b6bbd.
title: GTA7: /sudoku self-KO respawn command added
